releases.notes:
## Minecraft 26.3

Branch: `latest`.

### Changes
- Port typed JEI/RRV/REI compatibility to their real Minecraft 26.3 release artifacts, preserving readiness predicates.
- Do not carry EIV compatibility compiled against older Minecraft artifacts: no EIV 26.3 release was available for verification.
- Gate optional compatibility Mixins per loader and client installation. Pin NeoFormRuntime 2.0.31 to include external patch data in cache keys.

### Verification
- Universal Jar build and packaged loader metadata/Mixin class checks passed.
- Compatibility was checked against actual viewer release bytecode; readiness/config smoke checks and NeoForge dedicated-server startup without optional viewers passed. Full graphical UI and multiplayer-handshake testing were not performed.

### Download
Use `norecipebooksystem-universal-26.3-1.1.2.jar`. Install optional viewers with their own required dependencies.

## Minecraft 26.1.2

Branch: `26.1`.

### Changes
- Replace handwritten JEI/RRV/REI/EIV reflection with typed calls and narrowly scoped Mixin accessors, preserving readiness predicates.
- Use real Minecraft 26.1.2 viewer artifacts; optional viewers remain compile-only and are not bundled.
- Update development loaders while retaining declared minimum runtime versions. Pin NeoFormRuntime 2.0.31 to include external patch data in cache keys.

### Verification
- Universal Jar build and packaged loader metadata/Mixin class checks passed.
- Compatibility was checked against actual viewer release bytecode; readiness/config smoke checks and NeoForge dedicated-server startup without optional viewers passed. Full graphical UI and multiplayer-handshake testing were not performed.

### Download
Use `norecipebooksystem-universal-26.1.2-1.1.2.jar`. Install optional viewers with their own required dependencies.

## Minecraft 1.21.1

Branch: `1.21.1`.

### Changes
- Replace handwritten EMI/REI reflection with typed calls and a REI menu accessor.
- Gate optional compatibility Mixins per loader and client installation; preserve EMI config and REI filtering behavior.
- Keep Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge in one Universal Jar. EMI/REI release compatibility was checked on Fabric and NeoForge; matching official Forge viewer releases are unavailable.

### Verification
- Universal Jar build and packaged loader metadata/Mixin class checks passed.
- Compatibility was checked against actual viewer release bytecode; readiness/config smoke checks and NeoForge dedicated-server startup without optional viewers passed. Full graphical UI and multiplayer-handshake testing were not performed.

### Download
Use `norecipebooksystem-universal-1.21.1-1.1.1.jar`. Install optional viewers with their own required dependencies.
